messages:
maria_account_exec: Quick heads-up 60CapGuard procurement sent back the SIG with a hard ask: HSM-backed CMEK for any KV/cache used during inference and FIPS-validated attestation. Theyre blocking contract until we provide either HSM support or an approved risk exception. Need a short reply + internal sign-off path.

lia_sec_eng: Thanks Maria. Can you paste the exact SIG/CAIQ question?

maria_account_exec: Quote from CAIQ: 'Does the provider support customer-managed keys with hardware-backed (HSM) attestation for transient caches, model state, or any persisted token-like artifacts? If unavailable, list compensating controls and a vendor-signed risk acceptance.'

ankit_prod_pm: Product note: Hosted inference currently uses provider-managed KMS for ephemeral caches. Dedicated and Private support customer KMS/HSM integration. We should prepare a host-mode response plus offer Dedicated as an alternative.

raj_infra: Draft compensating controls for hosted mode (internal):
```
- No disk persistence: ephemeral KV kept in-memory only, strict GC on session end.
- Short TTL: 2 minutes default, configurable down to 30s.
- CMEK for all persisted artifacts (logs, traces, any dumps) with customer-provided key option for blobs.
- Enhanced access controls: mTLS between services, least-privilege service roles, and JIT credentials.
- Immutable audit stream: write-once logs shipped to customer region, retention 1 year, signed with provider key.
- Monthly attestation package: stack integrity snapshot + pentest summary (manual until automation).
```

raj_infra: Note: we cannot produce HSM attestation for in-memory RAM regions today.

lia_sec_eng: Add continuous integrity monitoring and anomalous key-use alerts. Residual risk assessment: "elevated" for highly regulated financials, otherwise "moderate". We'll need CISO approval for an exception.

kyle_legal: For external wording avoid saying "HSM not supported" bluntly. Suggest: "Hosted inference leverages transient in-memory caches with strict isolation and short TTLs; Redwood provides customer-managed encryption for persisted artifacts and enhanced telemetry as compensating controls." Also document the scope (hosted only) and that Dedicated/Private can integrate with customer HSMs.

maria_account_exec: Procurement gave us 48h. Can we get a signed memo + a customer-facing one-paragraph that I can send to CapGuard?

ankit_prod_pm: Ill produce the one-paragraph customer note and a parallel internal risk memo with residual risk = "moderate-elevated" and sign-off checklist. Raj: can you estimate how long to produce the manual attestation docs?

raj_infra: Manual attestation (signed runtime integrity snapshot + logs) = 5 business days for first package, then ~2 days for follow-ups. Automation would be ~8 weeks.

lia_sec_eng: I'll kick off an internal ticket SEC-2081 for risk exception and assign reviewers = [lia_sec_eng, ciso, kyle_legal]. Will request CISO approval by EOD tomorrow.

infra-bot: SEC-2081 created and linked to CapGuard PO: https://redwood.internal/tickets/SEC-2081 (assignees: lia_sec_eng, kyle_legal, ciso).

maria_account_exec: Great 60please drop the customer paragraph in this thread when ready. tagging @ankit_prod_pm @lia_sec_eng @raj_infra. Thanks! :pray:
